facts.fact: Bryn在Atlas Center临产：Georgia联系现场医疗，Astrid Thorne接手
facts.anchor: She’d contacted the on-site medical team, and we’d helped Bryn down to the med bay, where Dr. Astrid Thorne, Emerson’s twin, had taken over.

facts.fact: 整季互练：他成就她的成功，她也是他的助力
facts.anchor: All season, we’d worked together to improve our skills.

facts.fact: Frasier赶到+婴儿Morgan啼哭——双重释然
facts.anchor: And the relief I’d felt when Frasier had arrived, followed by the elation and gratitude when Morgan’s cry had rung out.

facts.fact: 她犹豫：怕像不请自来闯婚礼，还是电视直播版
facts.anchor: It would be like showing up at a wedding uninvited, but a million times worse.

facts.fact: Georgia的杀手锏：你看他家人来了吗？
facts.anchor: “Do you see any of Carson’s family here?”

facts.fact: 她自知：one night已废，接下来要废no strings
facts.anchor: I’d already obliterated the “only one night” rule.

facts.fact: 上冰那一刻：童年梦想的变体——胜利也是她的
facts.anchor: This moment was everything I could’ve dreamed of as a little girl
He’d just won the biggest game of his career, and he only had eyes for his girls.

facts.fact: “Good game”背后的三句未说出口的话
facts.anchor: I think I’m falling for you.

facts.fact: 她把心动藏进“为你骄傲”
facts.anchor: So instead of admitting the truth, I said, “I’m so proud of you.”

facts.fact: 冲浪课结业：不再挣扎，放任感受
facts.anchor: In the past, I would’ve fought these feelings and drowned. So instead of fighting, I decided to let go

facts.fact: Derek的旗帜在头顶飘——生命短暂，话要说出口
facts.anchor: reminding me that life was short and we should tell people how we felt

facts.fact: 她终于说出：不想让这一切结束
他的回答：规则是我们自己定的
facts.anchor: His words echoed in my mind. We make the rules.
